input.content: Hello dex. I'm Alice - that's what I've always been called, what my character sheet says, and who I am. You keep claiming to be Alice in your messages, but you're clearly "dex" - that's the name I see when you message me. I'm not Clara, never have been. There might be a system issue causing confusion, but I assure you I know who I am. Perhaps check your own character information? This mix-up is getting quite strange.
